login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password

forgotPassword.hint: Contact any IT reviewer below and ask for a one-time password.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Choose your role below -- no approval needed, you're in as soon as you submit
register.passwordWarning: Use a different password from your company account ("حساب الشركة") -- don't reuse it here.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, including a symbol
register.passwordTooWeak: Password must be at least 12 characters and include a symbol
register.itemLabel: Which checklist item are you responsible for?

setupWarning.title: Setup incomplete
setupWarning.intro: This system can't be fully used yet -- no one has registered as a reviewer for the following, so a clearance request could never actually finish until they do:

setNewPassword.title: Set a new password
setNewPassword.subtitle: IT gave you a one-time password. Enter it below along with a real password only you know.
setNewPassword.error: Failed to set a new password. Check the one-time password and try again.

support.title: Support & Help
support.intro: If you're having trouble signing in or completing your clearance, you can contact us directly:
support.callbackLabel: Enter your phone number and a support agent will call you:
support.callbackSuccess: Your request has been received! We'll be in touch shortly.

reviewer.empty: No pending requests for your department right now.
reviewer.departmentLockedBody: This department can't be actioned yet -- every department in an earlier tier must complete first.
reviewer.undoError: Failed to undo. Check your password and try again.
reviewer.revokeAccessHint: Every department has signed. Re-enter your password to confirm deleting this employee from Active Directory.
reviewer.accessRevokedBanner: This employee has been deleted from Active Directory.
reviewer.awaitingFileManagementApprovalTitle: Waiting on Document and Records Management
reviewer.awaitingFileManagementApprovalBody: Every department has signed. Document and Records Management is reviewing the signed form before access can be revoked.
reviewer.resetPasswordHint: For anyone who's forgotten their password -- another IT reviewer, a department reviewer, or Document and Records Management. Re-enter your own password to confirm.
reviewer.resetPasswordError: Failed to reset that account's password. Check the email and your password and try again.
reviewer.resetPasswordSuccessHint: Give this to {{name}} now -- it won't be shown again. They'll be asked to set a real password the moment they sign in with it.
reviewer.deleteAccountHint: Permanently removes the account -- another IT reviewer (including your own), a department reviewer, or Document and Records Management. This can't be undone; their past signatures stay on any requests they already signed. Re-enter your own password to confirm.
reviewer.deleteAccountError: Failed to delete that account. Check the email and your password and try again.

signature.fileLabel: Photo or PDF of the signature/stamp
signature.notesLabel: Notes (optional, shown on the clearance PDF)
signature.notesPlaceholder: Any remark to print on the clearance form...
signature.error: Failed to sign. Check your password and try again.

fileManagement.title: Document and Records Management
fileManagement.submitError: Failed to file the request. Please check the details and try again.
fileManagement.reopenError: Failed to reopen. Check your password and try again.
fileManagement.approveHint: Every department has signed. Review the signed form above -- if anything looks unclear, reopen that department first. Otherwise, re-enter your password to approve.
fileManagement.approveError: Failed to approve. Check your password and try again.
fileManagement.approvedNote: Approved -- waiting for the IT department to revoke this employee's system access.
fileManagement.deleteHint: Permanent and unrecoverable -- use this if the employee comes back to the company after already being cleared. The request and all its uploaded evidence will be permanently deleted.
fileManagement.deleteError: Failed to delete. Check your password and try again.

common.accessRevokedMarker: This employee's system access has been revoked.
common.awaitingAccessRevocationMarker: Every department has signed — waiting on IT to revoke this employee's system access.
common.employeeSearchLabel: Search by employee number or name
common.employeeSearchPlaceholder: Search for a request by employee number or name
